purpose: A deterministic three-action sequence with an exactly hand-computable result. Used as an arithmetic oracle for any encounter evaluator: damage must be counted once, action time must be charged, and a lockout window must not be billed as uptime.
not_a_claim: Durations and damage values are invented. They model no PoE 2 skill, enemy or animation.

oracle.naive_derivation: Ignoring the 4.0 s lockout gives 3200 / 6.0 = 533.33..., which is the error mode this fixture exists to catch.
